speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is still two fingers short. I paid the penny. I am not starting a quarrel with a stall on a playing day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny remains the price. He has Titus at two, and a reckoning after, and I am not feeding the company.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in it. I do not know what they will call the gown, and I am not asking at breakfast. The boxes open after.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat, and take the band at noon if you are still in the house. If you are counting out there, do not come home and count again at my table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write one line at home, if there is a line. I will not make your table a second tally.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I brush the band now?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At noon. The morning is the garret, and the garret has nothing that has to be finished before two.
